name: Composition Law for Simplicial Shelling Records
statement: For pure simplicial pieces over a common pure base $\Gamma$, with pairwise disjoint private vertices and one distinguished facet over each base facet, a global shelling record $(\pi,S)$ exists exactly when every piece has a local record $(\pi,S_i)$ with the same distinguished-facet order and the active sets $S_i$ are pairwise disjoint; then $S=\bigcup_iS_i$. Any chosen compatible local shellings can be interleaved while preserving every local order. When the base has one empty facet, this says that the polyhedral-join assembly is shellable exactly when every factor is shellable and all but at most one can start at its chosen facet.
proof: For compatible records, interleave local blocks between successive distinguished facets. Any earlier facet from another piece has its intersection with the current facet covered by an already inserted distinguished facet; simultaneous activity would be the only obstruction. Conversely, links in the fixed private blocks recover all local shellings. If two pieces were active at one base facet, a codimension-two link in the prefix would be a disconnected union of two stars, contradicting shellability. The one-facet base specializes activity to whether the chosen facet occurs first.
